tokens.name: surface-desk
tokens.usage: The desk: website page ground, app sidebar, group rows.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The sheet you work on: app work area, top bar, table header, sheet footer, cuadrícula paper.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Objects on the page: cards, pills, popovers, the post sheet, quiet controls.

tokens.name: surface-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of a quiet control or a list row on surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Only where you type: inputs, the caption box.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark fills: an active tool, your own chat bubble, the bulk bar, avatars, the button slot. Text on it is content-inverse.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Neutral hover in the sidebar and menus. Hover is never a highlighter.

tokens.name: surface-current
tokens.usage: Current item in a sub-list (a chat in the sidebar).

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table row, keyboard-selected menu row (with a line outline).

tokens.name: surface-danger
tokens.usage: Fill behind a failure: failed pill, invalid input, the danger button face. A clear peach, so it is never mistaken for stage-cambios.

tokens.name: surface-today
tokens.usage: Fill of today in the calendar, inside a 2px brand inset border.

tokens.name: surface-placeholder
tokens.usage: Behind media that has not loaded.

tokens.name: surface-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the command palette and dialogs.

tokens.name: content
tokens.usage: Default text and icons, on every surface except surface-inverse (11:1 or more, highlighters included).

tokens.name: content-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels, on surface-desk, surface-page, surface-raised and the stage fills (4.5:1 or more; 5.8:1 on surface-desk).

tokens.name: content-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse, brand and the dark helper inks.

tokens.name: content-brand
tokens.usage: The serif accent word and the stamp, on any paper surface (9:1 or more).

tokens.name: content-danger
tokens.usage: Error text, and the line of the danger button, on surface-danger, surface-raised and surface-page (5.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The one ink line that draws every object.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside an object: table rows, list rows, the second header band.

tokens.name: line-danger
tokens.usage: Border of a failed pill or an invalid input (3.4:1 on surface-danger, 4.8:1 on surface-raised). Always with "!" or words.

tokens.name: line-grid
tokens.usage: Cuadrícula lines on website paper and the client-approval stage.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive thing on a paper surface, solid, focus-width, 2px offset (9:1 or more against the paper around it).

tokens.name: focus-ring-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus ring for controls that sit on surface-inverse, such as the bulk bar, where cherry would not show.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Sello, today, unread dots, counts that need you, a checked checkbox, hand-drawn marks. Never a large fill.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The website footer. Text on it is content-inverse.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The default highlighter outside the app: website tags and callouts.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Face of the primary button (bottom of its two-stop face).

tokens.name: action-primary-top
tokens.usage: Top of the primary button face.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Label on the primary button (10:1).

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Top of the ghost button face.

tokens.name: action-secondary-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the ghost button face.

tokens.name: on-action-secondary
tokens.usage: Label on the ghost button.

tokens.name: action-danger
tokens.usage: Face of the danger button.

tokens.name: on-action-danger
tokens.usage: Label on the danger button (5.2:1).

tokens.name: stage-borrador
tokens.usage: Stage: draft.

tokens.name: stage-revision
tokens.usage: Stage: internal review.

tokens.name: stage-cliente
tokens.usage: Stage: with the client.

tokens.name: stage-cambios
tokens.usage: Stage: changes requested.

tokens.name: stage-programado
tokens.usage: Stage: scheduled.

tokens.name: stage-publicado
tokens.usage: Stage: published. Plain on purpose: done work is quiet.

tokens.name: stage-fallo
tokens.usage: Stage: failed. With line-danger and "!".

tokens.name: helper-copy
tokens.usage: Ink of the Copy helper (Globo). Eyes and text on it are white (10:1).

tokens.name: helper-revision
tokens.usage: Ink of the Revisión helper (Nota). Eyes and text on it are noir (9.4:1); never white. As a shape on paper it is only 1.6:1 to 1.9:1, so it never carries meaning alone: Nota is always read by its shape and eyes, and never used as text, a line or an icon.

tokens.name: helper-numeros
tokens.usage: Ink of the Números helper (Barras). Eyes and text on it are white (7.7:1).

tokens.name: helper-asistente
tokens.usage: Ink of the assistant (Domo).

tokens.name: figure-eye
tokens.usage: Eyes of every figure with a dark body.

tokens.name: figure-eye-dark
tokens.usage: Eyes of Nota, the one figure with a light body.

styles.name: stat

styles.name: view-title

styles.name: sheet-title

styles.name: heading

styles.name: body

styles.name: strong

styles.name: caption

styles.name: label

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Numbers that line up in columns: metrics, times, dates. Tabular figures.

styles.name: accent

border.note: One ink line draws every object.

tokens.name: line-width
tokens.usage: Outline of every object, in noir, solid. Dashed only for an idea or an unconfirmed result.

tokens.name: hairline-width
tokens.usage: Dividers inside an object, in rule.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring, solid cherry, 2px offset. 3px on the website.

size.note: Fixed measures that make lines line up across panels.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar and sheet header share it, so their bottom borders meet.

tokens.name: subbar-height
tokens.usage: Second band: filters, tabs, the sheet stepper, chat headers.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Full sidebar, from bp-rail up.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Icon rail between bp-drawer and bp-rail, or when collapsed by hand.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: Post detail sheet. Full width under bp-drawer.

tokens.name: site-width
tokens.usage: Website content column, with a 20px gutter.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Cuadrícula paper on the website. 22px in the client portal, 13px on small sheets.

tokens.name: bp-rail
tokens.usage: Below it the sidebar becomes the icon rail and side panels stack.

tokens.name: bp-drawer
tokens.usage: Below it the sidebar is a drawer, bars wrap, the week becomes a list, the sheet is full screen.

timing.note: Things respond like things: quick, short, no fades for their own sake. All motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
